title: Latest iPhone Rumors: Rising Costs and Pre-order Changes
description: Recent reports highlight potential cost increases for the iPhone 18 Pro and changes to its release schedule, according to market analysts and tech news outlets.

sources.title: iPhone 18 Pro BOM Cost Expected to Surge Nearly 40%, Leaving Apple to Sacrifice Margins to Sustain Shipments, Says TrendForce

sections.heading: Production Cost Surge
paragraphs: According to TrendForce, the Bill of Materials (BOM) cost for the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to surge nearly 40%. This projected increase suggests that Apple may need to sacrifice its margins to sustain shipments.

sections.heading: Impact on Margins
paragraphs: TradingView reports that memory costs are squeezing iPhone margins. This financial pressure aligns with the broader analysis of rising component costs for the upcoming devices.

sections.heading: Release Schedule Adjustments
paragraphs: The iPhone 18 Pro may not follow the usual pre-order cadence, according to PhoneArena. This indicates a potential deviation from the standard timeline established for previous releases.
